name: A Potion For Chamomile
source:
One day, Chamomile shows up to Lavender's house with a special potion recipe. She wants a transformation potion! Sadly she only has the recipe for a temporary one, so the two witches set out on a wild adventure to gather the ingredients for a permanent transformation potion!

[From [url=https://kyaniteheart.itch.io/a-potion-for-chamomile]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一天，洋甘菊带着一份特别的药水配方来到薰衣草家。她想要一瓶变身药水！可惜她手上只有暂时变身药水的配方，于是两位女巫踏上冒险旅程，收集材料来调制永久变身药水！

[来源：[url=https://kyaniteheart.itch.io/a-potion-for-chamomile]Itch.io[/url]]
